text:
kevin: Heads-up — customer reported confusing errors when using our SDK in Node 16. They hit undici ESM import issues and TS types missing (no DOM lib). Thoughts on a clear guidance + quick patch?

maya: We should publish short "edge vs node" section in README with recommended installs: Node >=18 -> rely on global fetch; Node <18 -> suggest `npm i undici` + note CJS/ESM caveats.

tori: +1. Also we can ship a light runtime adapter so most users don't have to change code. adapter should try globalThis.fetch, then try to require('undici') (CJS), then dynamic import (ESM). Keep failures informative.

sam: Implementation detail: requiring undici in ESM-only package throws in CJS consumers. Pattern that worked for us before: in ESM build use `await import('undici')` lazily; in CJS build use `try { module.exports = require('./dist/interop.cjs') } catch { /* fallback docs */ }`. We need to assemble CI tests to validate both bundles.

maya: Types: many apps don't opt into DOM lib. We can provide a tiny types file `types/fetch-helpers.d.ts` that exports minimal interfaces we use: `Fetch`, `RequestInitLite`, `ResponseLite`. Document that it's not a full DOM polyfill. Add a note to tsconfig recommendations.

kevin: Packaging size concerns? Some customers worry undici vs node-fetch adds bytes. We should quantify delta in README and recommend `sideEffects: false` and exports field to allow tree shaking.

tori: Retry behavior: ensure our retry wrapper normalizes network errors across runtimes. e.g., map undici `FetchError` and node DNS errors to our RetryError with codes. Add small helper: `normalizeFetchError(err)`.

sam: Also surface an opt-in `agent` option for Node users so they can pass undici's Pool/Agent; no-op for edge runtimes. Document that keepAlive only applies to Node fallback.

kevin: For migration path, propose a short snippet for README:
```js
// recommended usage (no changes for edge)
import { createClient } from 'redwood';
const client = createClient({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY });
await client.text.generate({ prompt: 'hi' });
```
And instructions: if Node <18 or using older bundlers: `npm i undici` or `import 'undici'` in app entry.

maya: CI: add matrix entries: node16 + undici, node18 (global fetch), bun (latest), deno (std tests). We can run a tiny smoke test that asserts successful call to mocked endpoint and consistent error shapes.

ci-bot: Added job `sdk-fetch-matrix` to CI pipeline. See https://ci.redwood/PIPE-8456

devex-bot: Filed doc ticket DOC-711: "SDK fetch polyfill + TS guidance". PR template updated to include `types` and `exports` checkboxes.

kevin: Action list: 1) tori prototype adapter (try global -> require undici -> import undici), 2) maya draft minimal types and README blurb, 3) sam prepare CJS/ESM build checks + CI matrix, 4) create tests for normalizeFetchError. I'll own release notes.

maya: I'll also add a short troubleshooting FAQ for common errors (undici import errors, missing lib.dom TS errors, agent/keepalive confusion).

tori: Starting adapter PR now, will ping reviewers when draft is ready.
